name: MMBench-EN
intro: MMBench-EN 是 MMBench 的英文子集/分项，报告中用于观察多模态模型英文视觉问答表现。
build_method: 公开数据集与互联网收集, 能力体系标注, 混合构建
eval_feature: 英文视觉问答, CircularEval, 选项抽取
build_method_en: Public dataset and Internet collection, Ability taxonomy annotation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: English Visual QA, CircularEval, Choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-EN is the English subset or breakdown of MMBench used in reports to inspect multimodal English visual-QA performance.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect MMBench questions from public datasets and Internet sources"] --> B["Organize items under 20 fine-grained ability dimensions in a three-level taxonomy"]
    B --> C["Release English development and test splits"]
    C --> D["Represent each sample as an image-grounded multiple-choice question"]
    D --> E["Run CircularEval by rotating options and requiring consistent success"]
    E --> F["Convert free-form model outputs to choices with rules and ChatGPT fallback"]
    F --> G["Submit English test predictions for official evaluation"]
    G --> H["Report English MMBench accuracy by ability dimension and overall score"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从公开数据集和互联网来源收集MMBench问题"] --> B["按三级体系中的20个细粒度能力维度组织样本"]
    B --> C["发布英文开发集和测试集"]
    C --> D["将每个样本表示为图像相关多选题"]
    D --> E["通过轮换选项并要求一致成功执行CircularEval"]
    E --> F["用规则和ChatGPT兜底把自由输出转为选项"]
    F --> G["提交英文测试集预测进行官方评测"]
    G --> H["按能力维度和总体分数报告英文MMBench准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the MMBench paper arXiv:2307.06281 and the OpenCompass MMBench repository. MMBench-EN is treated as the English split/subset of MMBench. The official repo lists EN dev/test splits, 2974 multiple-choice questions overall, 20 ability dimensions, image-grounded prompts, CircularEval option rotation, rule-based plus ChatGPT choice extraction, and official test submission.
